comments.author: ChronoAtog
comments.body_html:
I’m curious is there a way to change the gun’s MOA, as it’s just a laser beam even at long range compared to most smgs and better then most custom modified guns base.

1.33 MOA is VERY LOW, especially for an SMG with a 7.7 inch barrel. The MPX with a 14 inch barrel has around 1.76 MOA. Saiga 9 has 2.52, STM w/16 inch is 1.55MOA.

Suggestion

For a bullet hose with low recoil + low moa, I would prob add more MOA around the 6-7 MOA with the standard 7.7 barrel one has. If you want to try and balance the MOA with weight/ergo with longer barrels, there is legit barrels up to 16 inches to give it the current lower MOA it has.
